sources.entry: Reminders MenuBar - Simple macOS menu bar app to view and interact with reminders. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/DamascenoRafael/reminders-menubar/) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.one_liner: A macOS menu bar app for viewing, creating, and managing Apple Reminders without opening the Reminders window.
summary.what_it_does: Reminders MenuBar lives in the macOS menu bar and lets you view and interact with reminders there. It syncs with Apple Reminders through EKEventStore, so changes stay in step with iCloud-synced reminders. You can create reminders with natural-language due dates, lists, and tags, and mark items complete or edit due dates, priorities, recurrences, lists, and tags. It shows upcoming reminders over a configurable time interval and offers search across all reminders and filtering by list or tag. The menu bar display can show an icon, a counter, or the next upcoming reminder, and a global keyboard shortcut toggles the app.
use_cases: view upcoming reminders from the menu bar
add reminders with natural language due dates
mark Apple Reminders complete without opening the app
search across all reminders on a Mac
filter reminders by list or tag
show a reminder count or next due item in the menu bar
how_to_run: Or download the .dmg or .zip from the project's releases page and drag the app to Applications
On first launch, grant the app permission to access reminders when prompted (System Settings > Privacy & Security > Reminders)
notable: Works entirely through the macOS menu bar, with a global keyboard shortcut to toggle it
Syncs with Apple Reminders and iCloud via EKEventStore rather than its own data store
Natural-language parsing for due dates, lists, and tags when creating reminders
Localized into about 19 languages, with instructions for adding new ones
caveats: Needs user permission to access Reminders before it can work
